strategies.name: Fast Fifty
strategies.myth: If it's at 50% in five minutes, it's sending.
strategies.rule: Buy any coin that hits 50% bonding in under 5 minutes.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -67.3% at 60 min, 6.7% winners.

strategies.name: Final Stretch
strategies.myth: Nothing dies at 90%.
strategies.rule: Buy every coin the moment it crosses 90% bonding.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -90.2% at 60 min, 16.7% winners.

strategies.name: Graduation Chase
strategies.myth: Migration is the real launch.
strategies.rule: Buy in the first 90 seconds after a coin migrates.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -95.3% at 60 min, 10% winners.

strategies.name: Fat Dev Bag
strategies.myth: A dev who buys big believes.
strategies.rule: Buy at launch when the dev takes 5% or more of the supply.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -35.3% at 60 min, 6.7% winners.

strategies.name: Holder Rush
strategies.myth: A hundred holders in ten minutes can't be faked.
strategies.rule: Buy when a coin passes 100 holders in its first 10 minutes.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -77.6% at 60 min, 6.7% winners.

strategies.name: Clean Top 10
strategies.myth: Good distribution always runs.
strategies.rule: Buy at 40% bonding if the top 10 wallets hold under 20%.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -54.9% at 60 min, 13.3% winners.

strategies.name: Full Socials
strategies.myth: Real teams launch with X, site and Telegram.
strategies.rule: Buy at 25% bonding if the coin launched with X, a website and Telegram.

strategies.name: First Dip
strategies.myth: Always buy the first dip.
strategies.rule: After a coin touches 40% bonding, buy its first 30% drop from the high.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -27.5% at 60 min, 3.3% winners.

strategies.name: Short Ticker
strategies.myth: Short tickers run harder.
strategies.rule: Buy tickers of 4 letters or fewer that reach 25% within 10 minutes.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -58.3% at 60 min, 6.7% winners.

strategies.name: Volume Over Cap
strategies.myth: When volume beats market cap, it's early.
strategies.rule: Buy when 5-minute volume is bigger than the market cap, under 30 minutes old.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -44.4% at 60 min, 13.3% winners.

strategies.name: Buyers Two to One
strategies.myth: Twice the buys means it's going up.
strategies.rule: Buy at 30% bonding when buys beat sells 2 to 1 over 5 minutes (20+ buys).
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -58.2% at 60 min, 6.7% winners.

strategies.name: Slow Burn
strategies.myth: Slow coins are organic coins.
strategies.rule: Buy coins that take 30 minutes or more to reach 50% bonding.

strategies.name: Fast Seventy
strategies.myth: Seventy in ten is a runner.
strategies.rule: Buy any coin that hits 70% bonding in under 10 minutes.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -79.1% at 60 min, 0% winners.

strategies.name: Sniper Free
strategies.myth: No snipers, no dump.
strategies.rule: Buy at 30% bonding if snipers hold under 3%.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -66.5% at 60 min, 6.7% winners.

strategies.name: Second Wind
strategies.myth: Coins that come back are the real ones.
strategies.rule: Buy when a coin that hit 50% and fell under 30% climbs back over 50%.

strategies.name: Quick Grad
strategies.myth: Fast graduations keep running.
strategies.rule: Buy right after migration if the coin graduated within 15 minutes of launch.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -94.8% at 60 min, 10% winners.

strategies.name: Ghost Launch
strategies.myth: No socials means no team to rug you.
strategies.rule: Buy at 40% bonding if the coin has no X, no website and no Telegram.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -63.4% at 60 min, 16.7% winners.

strategies.name: Dev Still In
strategies.myth: If the dev hasn't sold, neither should you.
strategies.rule: Buy at 60% bonding if the dev still holds 3% or more.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -72.2% at 60 min, 6.7% winners.

strategies.name: Organic Sixty
strategies.myth: High organic score means real buyers.
strategies.rule: Buy at 30% bonding when Jupiter's organic score is 60 or higher.

strategies.name: Sub-Minute Ten
strategies.myth: The first minute tells you everything.
strategies.rule: Buy any coin that reaches 10% bonding within 60 seconds.
strategies.cause: Bled out and lost the coin flip: median -47.4% at 60 min, 0% winners.

strategies.name: Insider Light
strategies.myth: Low insiders, clean pump.
strategies.rule: Buy at 50% bonding if insiders hold under 5%.

strategies.name: Holder Velocity
strategies.myth: Holders up 50% in five minutes is a breakout.
strategies.rule: Buy at 20% bonding when holders grew 50% or more in the last 5 minutes.

strategies.name: Retrace to Sixty
strategies.myth: Buy the retrace from the edge of migration.
strategies.rule: After a coin reaches 85% bonding, buy if it falls back to 60%.

strategies.name: X Only
strategies.myth: An X account is all a real coin needs.
strategies.rule: Buy at 30% bonding if the coin has an X link but no website.

strategies.name: Dev Out
strategies.myth: Once the dev sells, the bottom is in.
strategies.rule: Buy at 50% bonding if the dev holds nothing anymore.

strategies.name: Late Grad
strategies.myth: Coins that take hours to graduate are survivors.
strategies.rule: Buy right after migration if the coin took 2 hours or more to graduate.

strategies.name: Thin Top, Fast Curve
strategies.myth: Speed plus distribution is the combo.
strategies.rule: Buy at 50% bonding under 10 minutes old if the top 10 hold under 25%.

strategies.name: Net Buyers
strategies.myth: Thirty net buyers in five minutes is demand.
strategies.rule: Buy at 25% bonding when 30 or more wallets were net buyers in 5 minutes.
